summary: Iteration 64 (Email Blast Composer) verified end-to-end. Ran 16 backend pytest cases (10 existing test_iteration64_email_composer.py + 6 new test_iteration64_email_extra.py covering /email/blasts decorator fix, builtin template PUT/DELETE, /email/upload-image, and test_only blast). All 16 pass. Frontend smoke test confirms: 5 built-in templates appear in compose dropdown by exact name and inject subject+body into RichEditor when selected; Templates admin tab shows all 5 builtin cards with Edit/Delete; Edit dialog opens with name/subject/body prefilled; Preview button renders live preview against a sample recipient; ResizableImage extension fully working — upload via toolbar inserts an image wrapped in ri-wrapper with 4 corner handles (ri-handle-tl/tr/bl/br), floating ri-toolbar with align (left/center/right), size presets (S/M/L/Full), remove button. ri-align-center correctly updates data-image-align attribute on wrapper. Width label '400px' visible after insertion (default width=400).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 6281 lines — recommend splitting into modules (email, members, hours, events, etc.) for maintainability.
_normalize_email_images uses regex over HTML; works for current shape but would be more robust with BeautifulSoup if templates start including complex inline SVG/img wrappers.

DELETE /email/templates/{tid} has no protection for built-in IDs; current iteration explicitly wants this behavior (admin can delete), but a soft warning UX prompt on the frontend would prevent accidental data loss since restart re-seeds but admin edits/customizations are lost.
test_credentials: admin@clubhaven.app / Admin123! — used as documented in /app/memory/test_credentials.md
seed_data_creation: Test cleanup: removed orphaned 'Dues Reminder' duplicate (created by an earlier failed POST-restore path) and any blasts with subject prefix 'ITER64-'. Built-in templates remain intact (verified post-cleanup).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 64 email composer (built-in templates, image normalization, ResizableImage TipTap extension) is fully verified. Regression suite at /app/backend/tests/test_iteration64_email_*.py — set REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL env before running pytest (or run via supervisor env). The DELETE-builtin test restores via direct mongo insert so re-runs are idempotent. ResizableImage requires a real file upload via toolbar image button — TipTap editor instance is not exposed on window, so programmatic insertContent didn't work via React fiber; the production-realistic path is set_input_files on the hidden input or expect_file_chooser.
rca of the issue: N/A — no issues found. Pre-existing 404 on GET /api/email/blasts (missing @api.get decorator) confirmed fixed and returning 200.
